name: Holly Wright
source:
Holly is Your Character's childhood best friend and one of her love interests. She is first seen in Chapter 2. 

Holly is generally quite a happy person, but is seen to be extremely nervous when put under pressure. She is also caring, mostly towards Your Character and her students.
